title: Article 3 SHAP Feature Importance — Correction Note
article: Computational Screening of TADF Emitters for Horticulture Lighting via Multi-Scale Machine Learning and Structure-Property Analysis

correction_summary.issue: The 'feature_importance' field in advanced_ml_results.json contains Random Forest Gini importance computed on the 8-feature dataset. This was incorrectly labelled as 'SHAP' in the Article 3 manuscript.
correction_summary.root_cause: advanced_ml_pipeline.py line 377 passes the RF model to compute_shap_importance(), and the fallback path (line 202-203) returns model.feature_importances_ (Gini impurity). No SVR SHAP computation existed prior to this correction.
correction_summary.corrected_values_source: run_svr_shap_verification.py — SVR KernelSHAP, 29 features, 5-fold CV, averaged over 3 random seeds (42/123/777)

model_configuration.name: Config F — SVR KernelSHAP, 29 features, 5-fold CV

shap_feature_importance_corrected.description: Mean absolute SHAP values averaged over 3 seeds, as percentage of total
shap_feature_importance_corrected.collinearity_note: T1 and S1 energies dominate (91%) because DeltaE_ST = E_S1 - E_T1 by construction. The CT-only ablation (Model D, R2=0.619, shap_svr_modelD_ct_only.csv) demonstrates that spatial descriptors encode genuine exchange-integral physics independent of this collinearity.

Model_A_energy_only.note: Confirms feature leakage: DeltaE_ST = E_S1 - E_T1 is an arithmetic identity in the dataset

Model_C_full_29feat.note: Authoritative model used in Article 3 manuscript

Model_C_full_38feat.note: 38-feature variant including additional proxy features; marginal difference from 29-feature

Model_D_CT_only.note: CT-only ablation: no E_S1, E_T1, HOMO-LUMO. Demonstrates that spatial descriptors capture exchange-integral physics.

files_added.results/shap_svr_modelC_configF_article3: Authoritative Config F SHAP output (29 features, 3-seed average) — cited in Article 3
files_added.scripts/experiments/run_svr_shap_verific: Self-contained script to reproduce Config F results
files_added.figures/feature_importance_747mol_v2_art: Corrected SHAP importance figure (Article 3, Config F values)

do_not_modify: advanced_ml_results.json is preserved as-is (Articles 1 and 2 may reference its RF results). The corrected SVR SHAP values are stored in the files above.
